{{Top|leg}}
'''Power condensers''' were power devices. When attached to [[DataSearch Engine 9C]]s, it allowed the device to find low-level encrypted files during search operations, but at the cost of destroyed programs and [[Scandoc/Legends|scandocs]] that it searched.
